package_registry.note: package.json private remains the npm publish guard. GitHub source and runtime tgz availability is independent and does not claim the @inspr npm namespace.

excluded_from_public_source: delivery contract validators and unused invalid delivery patches
frozen identity/delivery schema bytes beyond curated synthetic fixtures needed by package tests

system: git (private export builder only; extracted source tests must not require private history)
trash CLI optional for packaging cleanup; tests retain owned temp residue with a bounded warning when it is absent and never rm

ci.release_trigger: workflow_dispatch with explicit version coordinate from main or an exact version tag checkout
ci.release_gates: npm test, runtime/source build, admit-consumer-proof with annotated-tag peeling, admit-release manifest/commit binding; main CI success alone is not a release gate
ci.ephemeral_transfer: actions/upload-artifact is CI transfer only, not publication evidence
ci.retained_forge_assets: GitHub Release assets on refs/tags/{version} or refs/tags/v{version} via release/retain-forge-assets.mjs; tag target must equal checked-out commit; only the four declared asset names are allowed and extras/duplicates are refused; mismatched tags are refused before forge I/O; identical re-runs are idempotent and changed bytes are refused
ci.canonical_toolchain_enforcement: FLOW_SHELL_CANONICAL_RELEASE=1 on the release workflow; local BSD tar builds remain valid and are not byte-identical to GNU tar

reproducibility.boundary: Published bytes are reproducible under the canonical GNU tar toolchain. BSD tar may emit different archive bytes for the same tree; local macOS builds are valid for development but are not the publication basis.

prototype.note: The 0.0.0 prototype remains in Git history. First explicit legacy SemVer public coordinate was local 0.1.0; it is a superseded unpublished candidate whose dist artifacts stay immutable. This is not a calendar-version migration.

superseded_unpublished_candidate.note: Local 0.1.0 runtime/source artifacts in dist/inspr-flow-shell-0.1.0/ and dist/inspr-flow-shell-source-0.1.0/ must not be overwritten or repacked.

failed_public_tag.note: Annotated tag v0.1.1 at merge 9578d0d passed build but failed admit-consumer-proof because annotated tags were not peeled to terminal commits. No GitHub Release assets were retained; the tag and failed candidate bytes remain unchanged.

prepared_candidate.note: INSPR-382 adds opt-in sidebar bounds, compact readable headers and measured footer reserve. Publication requires exact approved merge/tag, canonical admission and four retained forge assets; source/native checks alone are not publication.

previous_published.note: Four retained GitHub Release assets verified; existing bytes remain immutable.

outstanding_coordinator_gates: Pass exact source and release-metadata approval plus hosted CI before tagging v0.1.3
Root-owned tag v0.1.3, canonical forge retention of four declared assets, and downloaded runtime native/consumer verification remain required
Published v0.1.2 assets and failed v0.1.1 tag remain immutable; no replacement or retagging
Package registry publication remains unauthorized; private:true stays the npm publish guard
Local unpublished0.1.0 and separate private candidates remain immutable
Published Aithema versions remain untouched; host dependency updates ship separately

handoff.review_verify: cd /tmp/flow-shell-source-review && npm ci && npm test && npm run release:build
handoff.provenance_note: private_source_commit is original opaque lineage from the reviewed source export. current_source_commit is the Git commit actually exported from the public repository. Runtime artifact manifests bind source.commit to current_source_commit under frozen schema 0.1.
